# Gamestr game definitions and portable controllers

> Draft Nostr message formats and a TypeScript reference implementation for game definitions and portable game controllers.

## Documentation

- [Reading and implementation guide](https://github.com/forgesworn/nostr-game-controller/blob/main/README.md): Current status and repository entry points.
- [Game definition draft](https://github.com/forgesworn/nostr-game-controller/blob/main/NIP-XX-game-definitions.md): Game metadata and advertised actions.
- [Controller draft](https://github.com/forgesworn/nostr-game-controller/blob/main/NIP-XX-game-controllers.md): Controller discovery and input protocol.

## ForgeSworn ecosystem

- [ForgeSworn library guide](https://forgesworn.dev/llms.txt): Find related libraries, tools and integration guides by task and runtime.
- [ForgeSworn on GitHub](https://github.com/forgesworn): Browse the organisation’s public repositories.
- [Project source](https://github.com/forgesworn/nostr-game-controller): Canonical source repository, documentation and release information.
